live_only_reason: This case tests whether one fact is adapted to distinct newsletter, blog, and social reader tasks; v0 runs one text-asset pipeline and has no cross-channel adaptation or distribution route.

request.idea: Evaluate channel-native adaptations of one verified fact.
request.audience: readers across newsletter, blog, and social channels

sources.text: A newsletter and an SEO article may share a verified fact while serving distinct reader tasks. A social post needs its own native shape. Auto-posting identical paragraphs would ignore channel purpose.
